entities.summary: Ditlev Conrad Blunck was a Danish-German painter associated with the Danish Golden Age during the first half of the 19th century. Ditlev Blunck was a painters & sculptors from Münsterdorf (1798-06-22, Münsterdorf–1853-01-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
